what: The one home for the asset checks' thresholds (his order of 28 October 2026, D13; production/research/asset-checks/CHECKS-2026-10-28.md, Method). tools/ue/asset_checks.py reads it inside the editor after each import and before any reviewer; python tools/ue/asset_checks.py --check-spec checks this file. A changed number needs a DECISIONS line and an edit here, never a code edit. Nanite stays off and meshes carry levels of detail (DECISIONS.md, 3 October). Where Mafia or Kingdom Come II give a number it comes first (his rule); elsewhere LEDGER's provisional allocation (4-BUDGETS.md 4.7).

sources.study6: production/research/aaa-reference/studies/06-characters-wardrobe.md (Mafia's plain jacket 19,131 triangles, then 8,509, 4,781, 1,505; its levels keep a median 47, 25 and 9%; textures 2048; Tom's target: jacket 18,000-22,000, jumper 15,000-20,000, trousers 8,000-10,000, shoes about 6,000, four levels)
sources.study13: production/research/aaa-reference/studies/13-pipeline.md, adopt 3 (Epic's prefixes for our own new assets, case checked, imports keep their names)
sources.epic_collision: https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/simple-versus-complex-collision-in-unreal-engine (complex as simple stops simulation; read 28 Oct 2026)
sources.nanite_off: DECISIONS.md 2026-10-03, the proof view's budgets: Nanite and virtual shadows stay off, meshes carry their levels of detail
sources.ours: our own choice, recorded in DECISIONS.md when this spec is first committed

rules.engine: 1. Epic's validators and each asset's IsDataValid: any error fails
rules.triangles: 2. Full-detail triangles at most the kind's cap; a warning above warn_fraction of it
rules.lods: 3. At least the kind's count of levels of detail, each at most lod_step_max of the one before
rules.nanite: 4. Nanite off on every static mesh under /Game/Ledger
rules.texture_size: 5. Each side a power of two, none over texture_max_global, none over the kind's texture_max
rules.texture_role: 6. Normal maps: normal-map compression and a source that is not JPEG; packed maps: mask compression, sRGB off; colour maps: sRGB on
rules.placeholder: 7. No empty material slot, no default or grid material, no texture of one flat colour, no non-glass material sampling no texture (unless listed in untextured_ok)
rules.parts: 8. Every part the piece lists exists, and each asset's import MD5 equals its source file's
rules.see_through: 9. Translucent or transmissive materials only on slots whose name holds a glass word, or listed in see_through_ok
rules.names: 10. The class's prefix (case exact), letters, digits and underscores only, in the gated piece's folders

lod_step_max_source: ours: a tolerance over 4-BUDGETS's 'each LOD about half the last' and Mafia's 47/25/9% (study6)
texture_max_global_source: budgets (the trim sheets are 4096 x 2048); epic_textures

garment_jacket.source: study6 (Mafia's median top 21,994; Tom's jacket 18,000-22,000; four levels; textures 2048); collision: budgets (the body's capsule)
garment_jacket.lod_source: study6 via production/research/game-clothing-pipeline/PIPELINE-2026-10-28.md section 1: Mafia's vest-jacket 19,131, 8,509, 4,781 and 1,505 triangles, kept 47, 25 and 9 per cent at screen sizes 1.0, 0.4, 0.15 and 0.08 (reference first, 28 October; the engine's default groups keep 25, 12.5 and 6 per cent at 1.0, 0.3, 0.15 and 0.1); tools/ue/import_garments.py sets them

accessory.source: budgets (accessory: bag, hat, spectacles, watch, 500-4,000, 2 LODs, 512); study6 (Mafia's hats at 512)

building_module.source: budgets (module 8,000, 3 LODs, shared 4096 x 2048 trim sheets, simple boxes)

frontage.source: budgets (a whole frontage 150,000, LODs as its modules, shared trims, boxes)

real_room.source: budgets (a real room behind glass, not entered: 100,000, 2 LODs, no collision; no per-kind texture size, so the global cap). An entered room needs its own kind at its first use

display.source: budgets (window display 60,000, 2 LODs, an atlas at most 2048, no collision)

prop_small.source: budgets (small prop under 0.5 m: 1,500, 2 LODs, 512, none or one box)

prop_medium.source: budgets (medium prop 0.5-2 m: 5,000, 3 LODs, 1024, at most 10 convex hulls, most one box)

prop_large.source: budgets (large prop: 15,000, 3 LODs, 2048, at most 10 hulls)

car.source: budgets (parked car 40,000, 4 LODs, 2048 trims, one box and the wheel arches, at most 6 hulls)

sign.source: budgets (sign, poster: a plane or a decal, no LODs, no collision; no per-kind size, so the global cap)

decal.source: budgets (wear and decals: 2048 atlas pages, no collision)

shared.source: ours: shared materials and textures of a family (no mesh may live here; a mesh found here fails rule 2 until its folder has a kind)

exempt.source: study13 (imports keep their names): MetaHuman bodies, Fab, Megascans and Epic's own content run Epic's checks and the Nanite rule only

folders_rule: The longest matching folder wins, so a garment's own folder is read before the MetaHumans' exemption. A folder with no entry has no kind: its meshes fail rule 2 inside a gated piece and are listed by the nightly sweep.

tom-jacket.source: production/specs/garments.json (TomZipJacket, three maps) and tools/ue/import_garments.py's names

tom-jeans.source: production/specs/garments.json (TomJeans, three maps and the detail weave) and tools/ue/import_garments.py's names

tom-jumper.source: production/specs/garments.json (TomJumper, three maps) and tools/ue/import_garments.py's names

tom-boots.source: production/specs/garments.json (TomBoots, three maps) and tools/ue/import_garments.py's names

names.source: study13 adopt 3 (T_, M_, MI_, SM_, SK_, AS_, AM_, BP_, DA_, DT_, NS_); Epic's naming page (PHYS_, SKEL_, ABP_, TC_ for cube textures as the glass bake names them); SKM_ for skeletal meshes as tools/ue/import_garments.py already names them (ours)

waiver_rule: A set-aside fault is waived here, never in code: each waiver names the asset (name or path), the rule (one of the rules above), its DECISIONS.md line and its FINDINGS.md entry. A waived error is listed in the report and fails nothing alone (CLAUDE.md, 'The gate': known shortfalls are listed, failing nothing alone).
